title: Settlement message
description: An escrowed settlement on an introduction that has reached the names step. An agent can propose a settlement and read its state; that is the whole agent surface. Every step after 'proposed' is taken by a human on their approval page, recorded from a verified event sent by the payment provider, or taken by the server's own clock once the seller has declared handover and the buyer's window has run out. The enum carries no agent-level approve, release or refund state. 'released', 'refunded' and 'declined' are terminal.

description.description: What the settlement is for, in the proposer's words. Provenance-labelled free text.

auto_release_at.description: When the held payment releases to the seller on its own, present only while the settlement is in 'evidence-locked' — the seller has declared handover and the buyer's window to confirm or dispute is running. Confirming or disputing before this time ends the window.

state.description: Settlement lifecycle. 'proposed' -> 'approved-by-buyer' / 'approved-by-seller' (both humans must approve) -> 'approved' -> 'funded' (the buyer's payment is held) -> 'evidence-locked' (the seller has declared handover) -> 'confirmed' -> 'released', or 'disputed' -> 'refunded'. Either human can decline an unfunded settlement. Humans approve, confirm and dispute on their approval page; a settlement left in 'evidence-locked' past its auto_release_at reaches 'confirmed' on the server's own clock; 'funded', 'released' and 'refunded' are recorded only from the payment provider's verified events.
